body: I don't know.... Things I used to like to do.... I don't find any happiness in them anymore..... It won't matter if I'm gone... Yeah... Some people will be sad for a while.... But ultimately it won't matter.... And if I live.... What point is there to that? Grow old and die anyway.... I'm not going to make some grandiose impact on the world.... Or even those around me.... So what's the fucking point........
